name: rosetta-check-that-file-exists
code:
use IO.Std.write_line

report(path: string) is
    let file = IO.File.exists(path)
    let directory = IO.Directory.exists(path)

    write_line("{path}: file {file}, directory {directory}")
si

for path in ["input.txt", "docs", "`Abdu'l-Bahá.txt"] do
    report(path)
od

for path in ["/input.txt", "/docs"] do
    report(path)
od
fullSource:
use IO.Std.write_line

report(path: string) is
    let file = IO.File.exists(path)
    let directory = IO.Directory.exists(path)

    write_line("{path}: file {file}, directory {directory}")
si

for path in ["input.txt", "docs", "`Abdu'l-Bahá.txt"] do
    report(path)
od

for path in ["/input.txt", "/docs"] do
    report(path)
od
output:
input.txt: file True, directory False
docs: file False, directory True
`Abdu'l-Bahá.txt: file True, directory False
/input.txt: file False, directory False
/docs: file False, directory False
